title: Awami League supporters protest in Bangladesh demanding Sheikh Hasina's return
seoTitle: Dhaka protest for Sheikh Hasina's return

tea.why: Supporters are demonstrating following former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's request for a passport to return to Bangladesh from exile in India.
tea.want: The return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh.
tea.changed: Nov 11: Authorities reported that police used tear gas and rubber bullets to disperse protesters in Dhaka and other regions.

summary: Supporters of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina have launched nationwide demonstrations in Bangladesh, demanding her return from exile in India. The protests, which began after Hasina announced she had requested a passport to return home, have involved road blockades and the burning of tires. In Dhaka and Gopalganj, clashes were reported between security forces and members of the Bangladesh Chhatra League, the banned student wing of the Awami League. Authorities have responded with tear gas and rubber bullets. Incidents of arson against vehicles have been reported, including a fatal fire in Faridpur that resulted in the death of a bus driver. The Bangladeshi government has rejected Hasina's passport request, labeling her a fugitive, and has called for her extradition to face legal proceedings regarding her previous tenure.
demands: Return of Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh
response: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the government would not allow conspiracies to disrupt national peace. Junior Foreign Affairs Minister Humaiun Kobir stated the government has rejected Hasina's passport request and is seeking her extradition.

deaths.text: A 60-year-old bus driver died from smoke inhalation after a vehicle was set on fire in Faridpur.

updates.text: Nationwide demonstrations begin following Sheikh Hasina's announcement regarding her passport request.
Police report using tear gas and rubber bullets to disperse protesters in Dhaka and Gopalganj.
